title: director.location/1 (draft, from docs/director/location-variety-plan.md)
description: data/director/location.json: where the fight roams (Encounter's location variety slice): the hero's variety trigger, the destination scoring weights, whether the sea is a destination, the villain's prowl, and which biomes can be destinations per role. DRAFT: the field types are read from the plan before the data exists, and the version string `director.location/1` is a guess that follows the other files' naming; Encounter's commit tightens it. Planet shares come from WorldBiomes.SEG at load, not from data. The file is hashed (DirData.dataHash). Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

excessStart.description: How far a biome's time share must exceed its planet share before the hero leaves it.

varietyW.description: The weight on a destination biome's excess share.

keepW.description: The discount for the way a fighter already moves (today's LURE_KEEP).

oceanSurface.description: Lets the sea be a destination (the surface only).

prowlTier.description: The villain's prowl starts at this power tier.

prowlAfter.description: Seconds away from towns before the villain prowls.
